cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before I answer about the office kitchen, what happened to the printer?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Paper jam. Now, why is there smoke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Did you cause the jam? I need that cleared up first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used sticky labels. Can we talk about the smoke now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Were they the labels marked 'not for printers'? Let's finish your statement before starting mine.
